title: Rehearsal
raw:
# Slide 1 — Lessons from incident response
Today I will share seven lessons from incident response.
These lessons are about judgement, preparation, and communication.
Let’s begin with what experience teaches us.

# Slide 2 — Seven lessons learned
Certifications provide knowledge, but experience provides judgement.
Start preserving evidence before rebuilding systems.
Request topology, asset records, logs and access before travelling.
Separate confirmed facts from hypotheses and unknowns.
Identity, firewall and hypervisor access must have clear ownership.
Communication planning matters as much as technical planning.
A responder must learn quickly, but high-risk decisions still require verification.

# Slide 3 — Knowledge. Judgement. Verification.
Effective response needs more than technical knowledge.
It needs judgement, evidence, clear ownership, and communication.
Thank you. I’m happy to take your questions.
